modern: It is in our power to have no opinion about a thing, and not to be disturbed in our soul; for things themselves have no natural power to form our judgements.

explained.summary: You can decline to form an opinion about something, and so stay undisturbed. Things themselves don’t have the power to make you judge them one way or another. The judgement is yours, which means the disturbance is optional.
